question: According to the passage, choose the correct synonym of the word ‘catalyst’.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Activator**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **Catalyst means a substance that speeds up a chemical reaction without being consumed itself.** (उत्प्रेरक)

 
 
• Example: Enzymes act as catalysts in the body to speed up chemical reactions.
 
 
 
• **​Activator means a substance that stimulates or initiates a chemical process.**(क्रियावर्द्धक)
 
 
• Example: The addition of the activator increased the rate of the reaction by tenfold.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the word "activator" is the synonym of the word "catalyst."
 
• Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 - Micro means small or microscopic. It is not a synonym of catalyst.(सूक्ष्म)
 
• Option 2 - Disregard means to ignore or pay no attention to. It is not a synonym of catalyst.(अवहेलना)
 
• Option 4 - Animosity means strong hostility or hatred. It is not a synonym of catalyst.(बैर)
